text: CommonLight is an AI-powered app that brings together teachings from various religious texts, including the Bible, Quran, Vedas, Torah, Tripitaka, and Guru Granth Sahib.
The app aims to help people discover understanding through the world's wisdom traditions.
CommonLight allows users to ask questions about topics such as love, suffering, purpose, or doubt.
The project was launched on Kickstarter with a funding goal of $112,982.
$84 was pledged towards the funding goal, but the funding was unsuccessful.
The funding period for CommonLight was from November 28, 2025, to December 28, 2025.
The project was last updated on December 28, 2025.
CommonLight's vision is to connect people rather than convert them.
The project is based in Toronto, Canada.
CommonLight is an application that shows how different faiths illuminate the same truth from their unique perspectives.
CommonLight allows users to ask questions about love, suffering, purpose, or doubt.
The AI in CommonLight retrieves real teachings directly from multiple scriptures, verified by translation and context.
Each answer in CommonLight comes with AI-generated narration for a calm, reflective experience.
CommonLight features Smart Tags to help users dive into topics like forgiveness, compassion, destiny, and faith.
Users receive real-time updates when their personalized answers and audio are ready.
CommonLight explores authentic verses from all major religions side-by-side.
The app includes audio playback and queue features for users to listen and reflect anywhere.
CommonLight addresses the growing issues of misinformation and religious polarization.
The app provides a safe space for users to explore what unites humanity at its core.
CommonLight has built a working beta app that is available on iOS.
CommonLight is an app that helps people explore common ground in faith and spirituality.
The app is available on iOS and includes features such as asking questions, receiving multi-scripture insights, and listening via generated audio.
CommonLight aims to scale, enhance AI precision, and cover API and hosting costs to reach more people worldwide.
Contributions to CommonLight will go toward API and infrastructure costs for scripture retrieval.
Funding will also support expanding audio and translation support.
UI/UX improvements for smoother experiences are part of the funding goals.
Outreach and community features will be enhanced with the support received.
CommonLight acknowledges that infrastructure and scalability are risks due to the need for stable cloud infrastructure for AI queries and audio generation.
Rapid growth could increase hosting costs for CommonLight.
To mitigate risks, CommonLight is using scalable cloud architecture with efficient caching and batching to ensure costs remain predictable.
There is a small risk of misclassification or partial context when using AI to retrieve verses from multiple religious texts.

CommonLight uses public-domain texts that are legally available for educational and non-commercial use.

The goal of the project is to make authentic religious texts more accessible, not to alter or reinterpret them.
